name: 2017 Diversity Report K-8 - Special Programs
description:
This dataset contains school-level demographic and academic data for New York City K-8 schools participating in special programs, drawn from the 2017 diversity report. Each row represents a school and special program combination, identified by a district-borough-number code (dbn) and school name, with the program name, category, and year recorded alongside enrollment figures.

The data includes total enrollment and grade-by-grade counts from kindergarten through eighth grade. Demographic breakdowns cover gender, race and ethnicity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White, and other), and English language learners by home language, including Spanish, Chinese, Bengali, Arabic, Haitian Creole, French, Russian, Korean, Urdu, and other languages. For most demographic and ELL categories, two sets of columns appear, likely representing different comparison groups or reporting periods.

Academic performance is captured through English language arts (ELA) and math test results, with counts of test takers and the number of students scoring at each of four proficiency levels, plus combined
